item.title: Organizers hope Dietz-Schneck Memorial Event attracts all-time high in registration
item.description: PINE GROVE — It’s impossible to put a price on the year-long worth of enjoyment to be had participating in the Annual Betty Dietz and Bruce Schneck Memorial Fishing Event at Sweet Arrow Lake. Of course, there is the $10,000 in tagged fish, including 100 lunkers with $100 tags, but a price tag can’t be put on the camaraderie to be had with other anglers. item.title: Following ‘Phantom’: How one musical became a reason to travel
item.description: The tour guide at the Palais Garnier in Paris spoke dramatically of the opera house’s marvels: Marc Chagall’s painted ceilings, the hidden signatures left by architect Charles Garnier, a stage so high it could hold the Arc de Triomphe.
